summary: Not approved. Part 11 covers Jinshu 109 units s0297–s0303 and s0113–s0143: Feng Yu’s remonstrance and Huang’s reply restoring Wang Xian and Liu Ming, the Longshan dragons and schools, Murong Ke’s Nansu strike, the 三年 Puyu raid with Jun and Ke, later undated administration, and the cinnabar-robed omen before Huang’s Yonghe 4 death. Jinshu never dates the remonstrance or Nansu locally; the pack fills them with AD 334-348 from 在位十五年…永和四年, which is a reign-long activity span, while ZZTJ 卷097 places that block and 拔南蘇 in 永和元年 (AD 345). Bare 三年 for Puyu is converted to AD 336 as Huang-year 3, but narrative order beside 永和四年 favors 永和三年 (AD 347), and ZZTJ narrates the raid under 永和二年 (AD 346) after Huang 自稱十二年 in 345—so every 336 point year and matching hint is incorrect. The omen’s AD 348 link through the continuous hunt–injury–death chain is supported. No birth or age is stated in the owned units; Huang’s death year is context-only here. This is not a full-chapter approval.

findings.problem: Undated remonstrance/edict (s0303, s0113–s0128) and undated Nansu (s0137) are given westernInterval or hints AD 334-348 from 在位十五年…永和四年. That is a reign-long activity span, not event uncertainty. ZZTJ 卷097 places Feng Yu’s remonstrance, Huang’s reply, and 拔南蘇 in 永和元年 (AD 345).
findings.action: Replace each affected attestation/dateContext with either undatedSourceAttestation (Jinshu-only) or a point/tight window anchored to ZZTJ AD 345 while preserving Jinshu’s lack of a local year as unresolved if both witnesses must stay; resync hints to AD 345 (or clear them). Do not keep AD 334-348.

findings.problem: s0138 三年 is converted as Huang’s third year from a 334 accession (=AD 336). That conflicts with (1) narrative order after 咸康七年/明年 and before 永和四年, which favors reading 三年 as 永和三年 (AD 347); (2) ZZTJ 卷097, which narrates the Fuyu raid under 永和二年 (AD 346) and states Huang only 自稱十二年 in 永和元年. Point year 336 hides the conflict.
findings.action: Mark each 三年-based value/dateContext unresolved:true with an unresolvedReason that preserves Jinshu 三年 (336 vs 347 readings) and ZZTJ AD 346; do not pick a winner. Resync hints; drop AD 336.
